description_en: Queries the details of session instances in a delivery group, including instance ID, instance status, creation time, update time, session status, and public IP address of the primary network interface
description_zh: 查询交付组内会话实例的详细信息，包括实例ID、实例状态、创建时间、更新时间、会话状态、主网卡公网IP等
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-app-instances --app-instance-group-id aig-4p5f8tj16yb8b0000 --app-instance-id ai-azn3kmwruh1vl0000 --status INIT --app-instance-id-list ai-azn3kmwruh1vl0000 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --include-deleted true --user-id-list Alice --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppInstances

parameters.help_en: The list of application instance statuses
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of application instance IDs. Maximum length: 100
parameters.help_zh: 应用实例ID列表，最大长度为100
parameters.name: app_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`. Default value: `20`. Specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`。默认值为`20`。建议填写该参数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results to display. Default value: `1`. Specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需展示的查询结果页码。默认值为`1`。建议填写该参数
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query information about deleted instances. If this parameter is set to true, the AppInstanceIdList parameter is required. Otherwise, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询已删除的实例信息。
该参数为true时AppInstanceIdList的字段必填，否则会报参数错误
parameters.name: include_deleted

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs. Maximum length: 100
parameters.name: user_id_list
